title: OTPrune: Distribution-Aligned Visual Token Pruning via Optimal Transport
reasoning: The paper focuses on improving the efficiency of multimodal large language models through a visual token pruning method called OTPrune. While it uses the term 'semantically faithful', this refers to the preservation of visual information accuracy during pruning rather than religious faith or ethics. There is no component evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics.
